description: This file defines a Spring configuration class 'WebConfig' that implements CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) settings for the backend server, allowing specified origins to access the server's API endpoints.

classes.name: WebConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for setting up CORS policies in a Spring Boot web application. Implements WebMvcConfigurer to customize CORS mappings, allowing cross-origin requests from specified origins.

methods.name: addCorsMappings
methods.description: Overrides the default method to configure CORS settings, allowing specific origins and HTTP methods, headers, and credentials for cross-origin requests.
